params.body:
The reading room stopped after its cards with no way on: the posts ran straight into the report band, the report band straight into the radar, and the radar into the footer.

- **More posts** under the post cards, before the report band.
- **More reports** under the report band, in the same form as on the public home page.
- **More trends** under the radar cards.

All three use the large underlined link that the home page already uses for More reports. Tests: 354 passing. Checked locally logged in as a test reader.
params.title: Reading room: More posts, More reports and More trends where each part stops
